curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42124-1-1.pdf (one book; no function page: pages 78-79 only show driving it from the Control+ app)

functions.does: The front motor steers the front wheels: it turns a crank across the front of the chassis, and two ball-jointed links from the crank's ends push the steering arms of both front hubs.
functions.source: book: steps 1-17 (the steering motor and crank), 18-38 (front suspension and steering links)
functions.note: The motor is one part; the crank on its output shaft (p318 32524 with p315 32316) is what it turns.

functions.does: The rear motor drives the rear wheels: a 36 tooth gear on its shaft drives the differential's 28 tooth ring gear, and the differential turns both rear half-axles, letting them turn at different speeds in a corner.
functions.source: book: steps 60-72 (the rear frame and differential), 77-99 (the drive motor and its 36 tooth gear, with the inset on page 55 showing the differential)
functions.note: The motor is one part; the 36 tooth gear on its output shaft (p889 32498) is what it turns.

functions.does: The differential lets one rear wheel turn while the other is held, or turn backwards against it when the motor's gear is held.
functions.source: book: steps 67-69 and page 55's inset (the differential between the rear half-axles)
functions.note: With the motor's gear held, turning one rear wheel turns the other the opposite way.

functions.does: Each front wheel moves up and down on its own pair of suspension arms (independent suspension), sprung by an extra-stiff shock absorber.
functions.source: book: steps 18-38 (the arms and the yellow shock absorbers)

functions.does: The front shock absorbers' springs hold the front of the buggy up.
functions.skip: only matters under gravity or force

functions.does: The rear unit (motor, gears, differential and rear wheels) swings up and down on a pivot at its front, sprung by two soft shock absorbers from the roll cage.
functions.source: inferred: steps 99-104 pin the rear unit to the chassis at its front and add the two long shock absorbers above it; the book doesn't show it moving

functions.does: The rear shock absorbers' springs hold the back of the buggy up.
functions.skip: only matters under gravity or force
